+ About the event

Student
Community Day.

For people who want to learn something, make something, or meet someone who sees things differently.

AWS Student Community Day Jammu brings students, educators, community builders and curious minds together at Central University of Jammu. The day connects AWS learning with hands-on exploration, regional innovation, startup conversations and meaningful community relationships.

Our commitments

Partnership principles

Programme independence. Speaking, workshop and demonstration proposals are reviewed for educational relevance and are not automatically granted through sponsorship.

Participant privacy. Attendee names, email addresses and personal information will not be shared without separate, explicit consent.

Brand use. Partner logos and assets are displayed only after written permission and according to the confirmed package.

No implied endorsement. Partner recognition does not imply AWS or university endorsement of partner products or services.

Administrative compliance. Contributions follow the university's approved process. Benefits begin after written confirmation and receipt of the agreed contribution.

Delivery timelines. Some benefits depend on receiving approved logos and material before production deadlines.

Contact & next steps

Let's build something meaningful.

To discuss a package or custom in-kind partnership, contact the organising team. A written confirmation will record the contribution, benefits, delivery dates and administrative process.

+ Before you join

Your questions,
answered.

Which workshops and technical sessions can I expect?

The programme includes AWS technical sessions, Skill Builder learning, the AWS Cloud Tournament and startup-focused conversations. Exact titles will be published as confirmed.

Are there activities before SCD?

Any confirmed lead-up activities will be announced through the official Meetup and community channels.

How do I register for AWS SCD Jammu?

Use the official Central University of Jammu AWS Student Builder Group Meetup link available throughout this website.

Do I need prior AWS experience?

No. The programme is designed for both first-time cloud learners and experienced student builders.

Who can attend Student Community Day?

Students, educators, community builders and learners interested in cloud and technology may register, subject to capacity.

How do I confirm my entry?

Keep your Meetup registration confirmation and institutional identity card available for event-day check-in.

What should I bring?

Bring your registration confirmation, a notebook and, if requested for a hands-on activity, a laptop and charger.

Will sessions run at the same time?

Yes. Selected sessions will run in parallel across the auditorium and R1–R2. The final agenda will show room assignments.
